component.name: Bongo
component.summary: Native Avro phonetic Bengali typing for modern Linux desktops

description.p: Bongo brings fast, natural Avro phonetic Bengali typing to modern Linux desktops (GNOME, KDE Plasma, XFCE). Powered by the pure-Rust offline transliteration engine with full dictionary suggestions and IBus integration.

ul.li: Complete Avro phonetic keymap transliteration (e.g. ami to আমি).
Floating candidate HUD with keyboard number shortcuts (1-9) and arrow navigation.
Configurable typing modes: Phonetic First, Smart suggestions, and Phonetic only.
Emoji completion toggle and Bengali typography customization.
Comprehensive phonetic cheatsheet with instant search.

description.p: Initial release of Bongo for Linux with IBus input method and GTK4 settings.
